item.title: Surprise shark caught on camera for first time in Antarctica’s near-freezing deep
item.description: Many experts had thought sharks didn't exist in the frigid waters of Antarctica before a sleeper shark showed up on a video camera.

item.title: Measles infection confirmed at Highland High School
item.description: Highland High School is warning families to watch for potential signs of measles.

item.title: Behind the RNC’s ‘warning’ text in Utah’s fight over Proposition 4
item.description: The Republican National Committee sent a text message this week in relation to Proposition 4, warning about a company working to convince voters to remove their names from a ballot initiative petition.

item.title: Heavy snow causes delays at airport, snow squall warnings and canyon restrictions
item.description: Utah's biggest snowstorm of the season has brought high winds, heavy snow, a delay at the airport and road closures.

item.title: Transportation Department says more than 550 driving schools must close over safety failures
item.description: The federal Transportation Department says more than 550 commercial driving schools in the U.S. that train truckers and bus drivers must close after investigators found they employed unqualified instructors, failed to adequately test students and had other safety issues.

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg quizzed on kids’ Instagram use in social media trial
item.description: Mark Zuckerberg and opposing lawyers dueled in a Los Angeles courtroom Wednesday, where the Meta CEO answered questions about young people’s use of Instagram, his congressional testimony and internal advice he’s received to be “authentic” and not “robotic.”

item.title: Takaichi, reelected as Japan’s leader, wants to cooperate with US in rare earths development
item.description: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi says she hopes to deepen her relationship with U.S. President Donald Trump.

item.title: School bus driver charged with sexually exploiting children
item.description: A former bus driver for the Granite School District was charged Tuesday with possessing child sex abuse material.

item.title: Envoys signal no breakthrough on bridging Russia and Ukraine’s political and military differences
item.description: The latest U.S.-brokered talks between envoys from Moscow and Kyiv over Russia’s all-out invasion of Ukraine have ended with no sign of a breakthrough.

item.title: Valley Behavioral Health began construction on 68-bed facility
item.description: Valley Behavioral Health broke ground on "Homefront," a 68-bed community housing facility for the unsheltered.
